{{Top|leg}}
'''Mallow''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was cultivated for its roots, which were harvested to be dried and ground to produce a sweet powder. This powder was then mixed with [[Water/Legends|water]] and cooked until a paste formed. It can also be used as a topping for [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
